title: Prepare experimental data for Al-P and Fe-Al-P systems
action: Compile the experimental data points required for optimization and validation: heat capacity of AlP, standard enthalpy and entropy of AlP, Al-rich liquidus compositions, melting point of AlP, vapor pressures of Al(g) and P2(g) over AlP, Fe-Al-P isothermal tie-lines, activity coefficients of P in liquid Fe-Al, and the solubility of P in BCC_A2. Digitize the numerical values from the cited publications and produce a structured file.
description: This step aggregates all necessary experimental inputs from the literature into a format usable by the optimization routine. The evidence file documents the compiled data points.

title: Fit heat capacity function of stoichiometric AlP
action: Fit the heat capacity expression C_P(T) = a + b*T + c*T^{-2} to the selected experimental heat capacity data for AlP. Report the fitted coefficients.
description: Obtain the analytic C_P(T) function that enters the Gibbs energy integral and is used in the subsequent optimization.

title: Thermodynamic optimization of Al-P and Fe-Al-P parameters
action: Using an open-source CALPHAD framework, perform the thermodynamic optimization. Adopt the published parameters for the Fe-P and Fe-Al binary subsystems. Optimize the Gibbs energy parameters for stoichiometric AlP (ΔH°_298, S°_298, and Cp coefficients) and the liquid Al-P interaction parameters. Extend to the ternary Fe-Al-P system using the Toop interpolation with Al as the asymmetric component and optimize ternary parameters as needed. The optimization must simultaneously reproduce the experimental melting point of AlP, the Al-rich liquidus, vapor pressures, and the ternary phase equilibria. Output the complete set of optimized model parameters.
description: The optimized thermodynamic database for the Fe-Al-P system.
output_schema: JSON object with required top-level keys "AlP" and "liquid". "AlP" contains "Delta_H_298" (J/mol), "S_298" (J/(mol·K)), "Cp" (object with a, b, c for C_P = a + b*T + c*T^{-2}). "liquid" contains "delta_g_AlP" as array [a, b] (Δg_AlP = a + b*T). Optional ternary liquid parameters in "ternary_FeP_Al".

title: Compute Al-P phase diagram
action: Using the optimized database, compute the Al-P liquidus curve. Determine the melting temperature of stoichiometric AlP and the liquidus composition over the full composition range. Output the phase diagram data.
description: Tabulated Al-P phase boundaries: melting point and liquidus as a function of temperature and composition.
output_schema: CSV with columns: T_K (temperature in K), x_P (mole fraction of P in liquid), phase_flag (character indicating the phase boundary type). Additionally, a row with T_melt_K and fixed composition x_P=0.5 for the congruent melting point of AlP.

title: Compute Fe-Al-P isothermal sections
action: Using the optimized database, compute the isothermal phase diagrams of the Fe-Al-P system at 450, 650, and 800 °C. Identify the phase boundaries and report the equilibrium compositions.
description: Phase boundaries of the Fe-Al-P system at three isotherms.
output_schema: CSV with columns: T_C (temperature in °C: 450, 650, 800), region_label (phase name, e.g., BCC_A2, AlP, liquid), x_Fe, x_Al, x_P (mole fractions for each phase boundary point or tie-line end-point).

title: Compute activity coefficient of P in liquid Fe-Al
action: Using the optimized database, calculate the activity coefficient of phosphorus in liquid Fe-Al-P alloys at 1400 and 1600 °C for Al concentrations up to 5 wt%. Output the results.
description: Calculated activity coefficient of P for varying Al content.
output_schema: CSV with columns: T_C (1400, 1600), wt_Al (weight percent Al in the alloy), gamma_P (activity coefficient of P, referenced to the 1 wt% standard state), log10_gamma_P (base-10 logarithm of gamma_P).
